meta.prompt: Using Denodo view admin.pg_vessel_positions_select, for vessel IMO 9231509 (TREND), identify the top 3 longest AIS transmission gaps between consecutive AIS records ordered by timestamp_date. Return exactly one row per gap with: vesselname, imonumber, mmsi_before, mmsi_after, last_ais_before_gap timestamp_date, first_ais_after_gap timestamp_date, lat_before=latitudedegrees, lon_before=longitudedegrees, lat_after=latitudedegrees, lon_after=longitudedegrees, speed_before, course_before, heading_before, speed_after, course_after, heading_after, gap_duration_hours. Sort by gap_duration_hours descending. Return all 3 rows.
